# CnLabelWidget

Single-line styled text label widget (font size, colour, weight, alignment) for dashboard grids.

Part of the dashboard widget library (v2). Registered with the dashboard widget registry and consumed by LaunchPad's widget grid. See [the widget library overview](./cn-widget-grid.md) and `docs/architecture/cards-and-widgets.md`.

## Tile group heading

With `groupHeading: true` the label is the heading of a group of app tiles ("Mijn apps"): a small uppercase `h2` on the page ground, start-aligned at the bottom of its cell. The style keys are ignored. The form offers it as the switch "Heading above a group of tiles".
